title: FOSS Foundation Schema
$comment: x-check on each property says how fdncheck (assets/python/fdncheck) checks the field against the foundation's own website: url = fetched, and a permanent same-site redirect may update it; fact = a short fact such as a name, date or identifier, flagged for a person to check; count = a number, flagged; choice = an enumerated or yes/no value, never inferred; text = descriptive text, never edited, only watched for changes on its source page; reference = an identifier that must exist in this site's data. x-values on a string property names the definition that lists its allowed values, each a oneOf const with a description; its pattern, which allows several values joined with '; ', must list the same values (checked by fdncheck's tests). Validators ignore unknown keywords; the x- prefix keeps it valid as an OpenAPI extension. Foundation pages render every property from this schema, in order, with its title and description (_includes/schema-fields.html); a property with x-includes is rendered instead by the named file in _includes, which is included once, at the first such property. assets/ruby/openapi_builder.rb generates openapi/v1/foundation-schema.yaml from this schema, copying only standard keywords.

identifier.title: Used as filename or fragment reference
identifier.description: Shortest unique and human-recognizable reference to org; lowercased; used for lookups.

legalName.title: Legal Name
legalName.description: The official name of the organization, e.g. the registered company name.

description.title: Description
description.description: One sentence brief overview of organization.

contacturl.title: Contact Us
contacturl.description: Contact Us or similar URL, if any.

website.title: Website
website.description: Primary website homepage that users would look for.

foundingDate.title: Founding Date
foundingDate.description: Date organization was legally incorporated (or similar).

dissolutionDate.$comment: EXCLUDE this field if organization still active
dissolutionDate.title: Dissolution Date
dissolutionDate.description: Date organization was dissolved (only include if needed).

addressCountry.title: Location
addressCountry.description: Country organization is incorporated in; ISO 3166-1 alpha-2.

addressRegion.title: State
addressRegion.description: State, Province, District, or similar region organization is incorporated in.

newProjects.title: Accepts new projects?
newProjects.description: Does this organization actively accept new projects for hosting?

softwareType.title: Software Types
softwareType.description: What general kind(s) of software does this org create? May be 'various'.

boardSize.title: Board Size
boardSize.description: Number of board of director seats.

boardType.title: Board Type
boardType.description: Approximate type of board: (non-paid) member elected; (paid) sponsor elected; appointed; self-perpetuating; etc.

boardurl.title: Board Website
boardurl.description: Official board information URL, typically with a list of directors.

teamurl.title: Team, staff, or employee roster URL.
teamurl.description: Team, staff, or employee roster URL.

missionurl.title: Misson Statement
missionurl.description: Mission statement or other overview of organizational goals URL.

numberOfEmployees.title: Approx Number Of Paid Staff
numberOfEmployees.description: Approximate number of paid employees or equivalents.

governanceOrg.title: Governance Description
governanceOrg.description: Brief description of corporate or organizational governance.

governanceTech.title: Project Governance Description
governanceTech.description: Brief description of project-level technical governance.

projectsNotable.title: Example Projects Hosted
projectsNotable.description: Example list of highly notable software products.

projectsList.title: Project List Website
projectsList.description: Official URL listing of all sub-projects hosted.

projectsServices.title: Services Provided
projectsServices.description: Brief description of services offered to hosted projects.

fiscalHost.title: Fiscal Host Type
fiscalHost.description: If a fiscal host, enter the type of services provided: direct funding, indirect funding, employee services, etc. Values in use: direct, indirect, full. Not the same as fiscalHost in the sponsorships schema, which holds the _foundations identifier of a program's host.

eventurl.title: Events Listing
eventurl.description: Link to any event calendar or overview page.

nonprofitStatus.title: Nonprofit Type
nonprofitStatus.description: Specific type of non-profit: a Schema.org NonprofitType (https://schema.org/NonprofitType) where one fits, else our own value named for the ISO 3166 country code and the local legal form or status. When an organization holds more than one, such as a legal form and a tax status, or entities in two countries, they are joined with '; '. Values are listed, with what each means, in definitions/nonprofitType of https://github.com/Punderthings/fossfoundation/blob/main/_data/foundations-schema.json and on https://fossfoundation.info/fdnmodel.

taxID.title: Tax Authority ID
taxID.description: US IRS EIN/TIN, or other country's tax identifier (if any).

taxIDLocal.title: Local Tax Authority ID
taxIDLocal.description: Per-state, province, or similar tax ID for the corporate entity.

uniqueEntityID.title: Unique Entity ID
uniqueEntityID.description: US Government UEI string used for grants or contracts.

budgetUsd.title: Budget in USD
budgetUsd.description: Approximate annual budget in USD; estimate.

budgetYear.title: Budget Year
budgetYear.description: Fiscal year budgetUsd number was entered for.

budgeturl.title: Budget Website
budgeturl.description: Official budget or other financial information URL.

budgetTransparent.title: Budget Transparency
budgetTransparent.description: Is the official budget shared publicly and fully on a regular schedule?

funding.title: Funding Sources
funding.description: Primary funding sources in rough order: (corporate) sponsors; (individual) donations; grants; other.

donateurl.title: Donation Link
donateurl.description: Link to donate or financial contribution URL.

sponsorurl.title: Sponsor List Website
sponsorurl.description: Official listing of sponsors from a published sponsorship program URL.

sponsorList.title: Example Sponsors
sponsorList.description: Example listing of top-level annual recurring sponsors from the most recent year.

sponsorships.title: Sponsorship Program Model
sponsorships.description: Name(s) of mapping files defining sponsorship levels, listings, etc.; see sponsorships-schema.json

licenses.title: Licenses Used
licenses.description: Licenses used on software provided if there is a policy; SPDX Identifiers or 'various'.

claPolicy.title: CLA Policy
claPolicy.description: Does the organization use CLAs, DCOs, or other required incoming grants from developers?

securityurl.title: Security Policy
securityurl.description: Link to any security reporting, advisory, or similar URL.

ethicsPolicy.title: Ethics/COI Policy
ethicsPolicy.description: Link to any primary ethics or COI policies posted.

conducturl.title: Code Of Conduct Website
conducturl.description: Link to official Code of Conduct.

conductEvents.title: Event Code Of Conduct Website
conductEvents.description: Link to official event-related Code of Conduct.

conductProjects.title: Per-Project Codes Of Conduct
conductProjects.description: Links to any hosted project or initiative COCs.

conductSource.title: Source Of Code Of Conduct
conductSource.description: Cited sources or inspirations for Code of Conduct policy; see opensourceconduct.com.

conductLinked.title: Where Code Of Conduct Linked
conductLinked.description: Describe where the Code of Conduct is linked from the website - footer, header, navigation, none?

conductReport.title: How To Report COC Violations
conductReport.description: Brief description of how to report violations of the Code of Conduct.

diversityPolicy.title: Diversity Policy Website
diversityPolicy.description: Diversity, inclusion, or other related policies or informational page.

diversityDescription.title: Description Of Diversity Policy
diversityDescription.description: Brief description of the diversityPolicy link.

brandPrimary.title: Primary Brand Name
brandPrimary.description: What is the primary brand name/trademark of the organization?

brandSecondary.title: Secondary Brand Name(s)
brandSecondary.description: Example listing of any major secondary brand names/marks.

brandReg.title: Is Primary Brand Registered?
brandReg.description: Is the primary brand a registered trademark in at least one jurisdiction? (yes/no/or major countries registered in).

brandPolicy.title: Trademark Policy Website
brandPolicy.description: Link to official trademark usage policies.

brandUse.title: Trademark Usage Website
brandUse.description: Link to official trademark FAQ or other policies.

brandComments.title: Trademark Policy Description
brandComments.description: Brief description of trademark usage policies.

logo.title: Official Logo Link
logo.description: Official organizational logo URL; prefer SVG when available.

logoReg.title: Is Logo Registered?
logoReg.description: Is the official logo a registered trademark? (yes/no/or major countries registered in).

subOrganization.title: Sub Entities Governed
subOrganization.description: Identifiers of subprojects tracked in _entities data.

US: a non-profit corporation under the law of a US state, without a recorded IRS 501 status. Our own value.
